# Innovation, Growth, and Market Outlook: Yoram Salinger, CEO of Valens Semiconductor, on Borsa Live


September 7, 2026


In this interview on Borsa Live, Channel 10’s financial markets program, Yoram Salinger, CEO of Valens Semiconductor, discusses the company’s core business activities, industry-leading technological innovations, and long-term growth strategy. Learn how Valens is leveraging its technology leadership and expanding market opportunities to drive sustainable growth and create long-term value.
